resources.string: Prevents removing MaxCare Kids without the parent\'s permission.
While this is on, MaxCare Kids cannot be removed. Only a parent should turn it off, in the MaxCare Kids app with the parent password.
Without this, MaxCare Kids cannot protect this phone. Protection should be turned off by a parent in the MaxCare Kids app, with the parent password.
Shows that MaxCare Kids protection is on.
